title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Awareness and Current Affairs - State Initiatives
subject: General Awareness and Current Affairs

questions.q: In May 2025, which state/union territory government approved five cloud-seeding trials at an outlay of ₹3.21 crore to combat air pollution?
questions.explain: To combat severe air pollution, the Delhi Government in May 2025 sanctioned ₹3.21 crore for conducting five cloud-seeding trials over the National Capital Region.
